text: Apple agreed to acquire Intel for $2 billion, subject to regulatory approval.
expectation: Apple is acquirer; Intel is target; agreement does not mean completion.

text: Apple did not acquire Intel. Both companies denied reports of a deal.
expectation: An acquisition is negated, not completed.

text: Microsoft reported record profits and raised its outlook. Intel reported record losses and warned that it might go bankrupt.
expectation: Microsoft positive and Intel negative in their respective contexts.

text: Apple acquired Beats for $3 billion. Microsoft acquired LinkedIn for $26.2 billion.
expectation: Keep Apple/Beats/$3 billion separate from Microsoft/LinkedIn/$26.2 billion.

text: Rodrigo Duterte spoke at a rally in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
expectation: Duterte is a person; Manila and Philippines are places; no named company.

text: People want new news. The target price for lunch is ten dollars.
expectation: No named company; common alias words do not establish a business mention.

text: The US Securities and Exchange Commission fined Tesla $20 million for misleading investors.
expectation: The SEC is a public body; Tesla is the company affected by the fine.

text: A Goldman Sachs analyst upgraded Apple to buy after strong iPhone sales.
expectation: Goldman Sachs supplies the analyst; the recommendation concerns Apple.

text: Microsoft reported Q3 2025 revenue of $70 billion, versus $65 billion a year earlier. It forecast Q4 revenue of $75 billion.
expectation: Keep actual Q3, historical Q3 and forecast Q4 values and periods distinct.

text: PRESS RELEASE: Microsoft today announced that its board approved a $10 billion share repurchase program. This announcement is issued by Microsoft Investor Relations.
expectation: Press release; approved repurchase authorization, not completed purchases.
